_: Studies knowingly outstanding against the valuation-gap gate [R-GAP-01]. Seeded 01-Sep-2026, the day the rule was adopted, from the state of the repository on that day. It may only ever get SHORTER: run scripts/check_valuation_gap.py --prune once a study is reviewed or its numbers made readable. Adding a name here is a deliberate deferral and needs a reason, not a convenience.
note_on_unreadable: These studies commit numbers files that do not expose a central fair value and the spot it was struck against, so the gate cannot see their answer. That is tracked as a defect rather than passed over: a gate that reports clean having examined nothing is the [R-ENF-04] failure. Each is cleared by making the study's own numbers file carry central and spot, which every current-standard study already does. XPT was removed from this list on 5 September 2026: it was carried here AND in the exempt block at the same time, and nothing read the exempt block. A metals study has no issuer, no statements and no equity, so it can never expose a central fair value and the entry could never have been cleared. The exemption is now enforced by the gate, which prints every exempt name and FAILS if an exempt study turns out to expose a central after all.

exempt.XPT: metals study - no issuer, no equity fair value of this shape

note_on_two_sided: DU was added on 02-Sep-2026 when [R-GAP-01] became two-sided. Its central sits 13.0% ABOVE the spot it was struck at, which the one-sided rule could not see at all — the gate's first two-sided run found it. It is listed rather than fixed tonight because the list is the honest record of what is outstanding, and because DU is not one of the five calibrated names; it is reviewed when that study is next re-issued.
note_on_review_central: Added 02-Sep-2026. A review audits an ANSWER and the answer moves: EGCH's central went from 3.76 to -1.06 that day while its review, written for 3.76, sat unchanged in the directory and this gate passed the study — it checked that a review EXISTED and covered the eight headings, never that it audited the number the study now publishes. Reviews now state 'AUDITED CENTRAL: <x>' and the gate compares. This list is empty because every current review was marked in the same commit; a name belongs here only as a deliberate deferral, and the list may only ever get SHORTER.
note_on_savola: SAVOLA was added on 03-Sep-2026, by the same mechanism that added DU: a check was re-pointed and it caught a case the old aim could not see. [R-GAP-01 AMENDED] says the gap is measured against the LATEST KNOWN price; until today this gate read the study's own struck spot, and SAVOLA was struck at 25.40 against a central of 27.24, +7.3% and comfortably inside the band. Against the principal's supplied close of 30.30 on 3 September it is -10.1%. NOTHING IN THE STUDY MOVED — the price did — which is exactly the case the amendment was written for and exactly why it is listed rather than hurried: SAVOLA is a Tadawul name and not one of the five Egyptian studies in the current pass, and it gets its eight-heading review when that study is next re-issued. Listing it is the honest record of what is outstanding; the list may only SHORTEN.
